<!-- sentry -->
<script src="https://js.sentry-cdn.com/6c08f35e971a4ca19dc1650cd1d1ff7f.min.js" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>
<script src="https://browser.sentry-cdn.com/10.26.0/captureconsole.min.js"
  integrity="sha384-sWqHK3BkVxkrsoV5x+Dz+0/FKDdbqtVzG6M/D40WRwqUQwqcOUUuaeQXWd3f8BnD" crossorigin="anonymous"></script>
<script>
  const isStaging = window.location.href.toLowerCase().includes('wpcomstaging');
  const environment = isStaging ? 'staging' : 'production';
  
  // Determine site domain for differentiation
  const hostname = window.location.hostname;
  
  // Domain mapping for site identification (order matters - most specific first)
  const domainMappings = [
    { pattern: 'learn.interviewkickstart.com', site: 'learn' },
    { pattern: 'learninterviewkickstartcom.wpcomstaging.com', site: 'learn' },

    { pattern: 'ininterviewkickstart.wpcomstaging.com', site: 'india' },
    { pattern: 'in.interviewkickstart.com', site: 'india' },

    { pattern: 'interviewkickstart.wpcomstaging.com', site: 'organic' },
    { pattern: 'www.interviewkickstart.com', site: 'organic' },
    { pattern: 'interviewkickstart.com', site: 'organic' },
  ];
  
  const siteDomain = domainMappings.find(mapping => hostname.includes(mapping.pattern))?.site || 'unknown';

  Sentry.init({
    dsn: "https://6c08f35e971a4ca19dc1650cd1d1ff7f@o429184.ingest.us.sentry.io/4504994110767104",
    environment: environment,
    initialScope: {
      tags: {
        site: siteDomain,
        domain: hostname
      }
    },
    tracesSampleRate: isStaging ? 1.0 : 0.5,
    debug: false,
    sendDefaultPii: isStaging,
    // Note: Currently exprimenting this on learn only.
    allowUrls: [
      // Only capture errors from Interview Kickstart domains
      /https?:\/\/(www\.)?interviewkickstart\.com/,
      /https?:\/\/learn\.interviewkickstart\.com/,
      /https?:\/\/in\.interviewkickstart\.com/,
      // Staging domains
      /https?:\/\/.*\.wpcomstaging\.com/,
    ],
    ignoreErrors: [
      // Exact matches for known error messages
      "failed to send metrics",
      "Event `ErrorEvent` captured as exception with message `Script error.`",

      // Third-party service errors (unactionable)
      "TypeError: Failed to fetch (get.geojs.io)",
      "n: HTTP error: TypeError: Failed to fetch",
      "TypeError: Failed to fetch (psb.taboola.com)",
      "TypeError: undefined is not an object (evaluating 'OptiMonkRegistry.features.TRACK_JS')",
      "Sentry.captureConsoleIntegration is not a function",
      "Multiple Sentry Session Replay instances are not supported",
      "Failed to fetch",

      // Regex patterns for flexible matching
      /Script error\.?/i,
      /Request failed with status 0/i,
      /Load failed/i,
      /bugsnag/i,
      /figpii\.com/i,
      /Event `ErrorEvent` captured as exception/i,
      /^Failed to fetch$/, // Network-related errors, unactionable (chrome)
      /get\.geojs\.io/i, // GeoJS geolocation service
      /psb\.taboola\.com/i, // Taboola advertising service
      /OptiMonkRegistry/i, // OptiMonk tracking service
      /jfclientsdk/i, // JetFabric SDK errors
    ],

    integrations: [
      Sentry.captureConsoleIntegration({
        levels: ['error']
      })
    ]
  });

  console.log(`Sentry initialized for ${environment} on ${siteDomain} (${hostname})`);

  // Dispatch custom event when Sentry is initialized
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('sentryInitialized', {
      detail: { environment: environment }
    }));
  }
</script>
